purpose: The complete Obsidian callout (admonition) type set with aliases, the machine-readable companion to references/formatting.md. Each entry is one rendered style; the listed types are interchangeable aliases for it. Type matching is case-insensitive. The render syntax is `> [!type]`, with `-` for collapsed-by-default, `+` for expanded-but-foldable, and trailing text as a custom title.

syntax.body: arbitrary markdown on subsequent `>` lines (lists, code, tables, nested callouts)

callouts.use: a failed check or a gap

github_alert_subset.note: When a file is LEAVING the vault for GitHub, only five alert types render, written in UPPERCASE blockquote form. Everything else degrades to a plain blockquote.
github_alert_subset.limit: one or two per document; do not nest
